COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

3. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.
   B. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   D. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   D. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.
   C. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

7. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.
   C. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.
   C. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   B. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   D. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.

12. Which statement about Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte.
   C. Treat Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte as rumours only.
   D. Explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Consensus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification Process and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship 4.1 Social Enterprise  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
